name: Net Speed Colour
author: brightwalker25
description: Live upload and download on the physical network link, with the VPN tunnel and daily usage in a panel

barWidget.description: Upload over download for the physical Wi-Fi or Ethernet link, never a tunnel or kill-switch interface. The panel shows the VPN tunnel beside it, a short speed graph and the data used today and over the last seven days

schema.label: Refresh interval (ms)
schema.description: How often the rates are measured. The collector only reads counters under /sys, so a second is cheap.

schema.label: Interface
schema.description: auto picks the physical link that carries the default route. Give an interface name to pin it instead.

schema.label: Units
schema.description: bits shows Kb/s and Mb/s (1000 base), as broadband speeds are quoted; bytes shows KB/s and MB/s (1024 base). Both change unit with the speed.
